Examples are local synthetic fixtures and command references; they do not establish release, publication, or security approval.

### [`examples/scanner-cli/ci-commands.txt`](../../../examples/scanner-cli/ci-commands.txt)

```text
# Run from the repository root on Node.js 22.
# The CI runner checks out this repository before running these commands.
npm ci
npm run typecheck --workspace sfscanner
npx --no-install vitest run packages/scanner-cli/src/v2/help.test.ts scripts/check-cli-docs.test.mjs --config packages/scanner-cli/vitest.config.ts
npm run check:cli-docs
npx --no-install tsx examples/scanner-cli/validate-config.mjs
```

### [`examples/synthetic-risky-workflow.json`](../../../examples/synthetic-risky-workflow.json)

```json
{
  "name": "Synthetic command review example",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "parameters": {},
      "id": "synthetic-risky-start",
      "name": "Start",
      "type": "n8n-nodes-base.manualTrigger",
      "typeVersion": 1,
      "position": [
        0,
        0
      ]
    },
    {
      "parameters": {
        "command": "printf 'synthetic review fixture'"
      },
      "id": "synthetic-risky-command",
      "name": "Review command",
      "type": "n8n-nodes-base.executeCommand",
      "typeVersion": 1,
      "position": [
        240,
        0
      ]
    }
  ],
  "connections": {
    "Start": {
      "main": [
        [
          {
            "node": "Review command",
            "type": "main",
            "index": 0
          }
        ]
      ]
    }
  },
  "active": false,
  "settings": {},
  "versionId": "synthetic-risky-v1"
}
```
